exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Cloud Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Unrestricted ingress to storage endpoints directly enables attackers to access and exfiltrate data from cloud storage without barriers.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
exploitedBy.relevance: Open ingress to storage endpoints can be exploited to exfiltrate data over web-based storage services.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Absence of egress filtering allows attackers to exfiltrate data directly to external cloud storage destinations.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
exploitedBy.relevance: Without egress filtering, attackers can use alternative protocols to exfiltrate data from the storage zone undetected.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Trusted Relationship
exploitedBy.relevance: Overly broad cross-zone trust allows attackers to leverage trusted relationships to move laterally across zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Trust Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Broad trust propagation can be abused by modifying trust settings to escalate privileges across zone boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Boundary Bridging
exploitedBy.relevance: Overly permissive cross-zone trust effectively bridges network boundaries, enabling attackers to bypass segmentation controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Valid Accounts
exploitedBy.relevance: Shared credentials across zone boundaries allow attackers who compromise one set of credentials to access multiple zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Additional Cloud Credentials
exploitedBy.relevance: Shared credential planes can be exploited to create or abuse additional cloud credentials spanning multiple zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Cloud Storage Object Discovery
exploitedBy.relevance: Lack of segmentation enables attackers to enumerate cloud storage objects from a compromised database tier.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Indicator Blocking
exploitedBy.relevance: Blind spots in east-west traffic monitoring allow attackers to block or evade detection indicators during lateral movement.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: Monitoring gaps on east-west traffic enable attackers to sniff internal network communications without detection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Protocol Tunneling
exploitedBy.relevance: When management and data planes share a boundary, attackers can tunnel management traffic through data plane channels to evade controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Presigned URLs function as time-limited access tokens that can bypass boundary controls when intercepted or leaked.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Presigned URLs act as application access tokens that can be stolen to bypass storage boundary controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Scanning IP Blocks
exploitedBy.relevance: Broad CIDR ranges in boundary rules expose the storage environment to IP block scanning from a wide range of sources.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal or Forge Authentication Certificates
exploitedBy.relevance: Without mutual authentication, forged or stolen certificates cannot be detected at the zone boundary, enabling impersonation attacks.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: DNS
exploitedBy.relevance: Unconstrained DNS resolution enables attackers to use DNS as a covert command-and-control channel from within the storage zone.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Fast Flux DNS
exploitedBy.relevance: Without DNS constraints in the storage zone, attackers can leverage fast flux DNS to evade detection and maintain persistent access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: DNS Server
exploitedBy.relevance: Unconstrained DNS allows attackers to redirect storage zone queries to attacker-controlled DNS servers for data interception or exfiltration.
